states.claim: profile points to the EXIF StringInfo obtained from the image profile; if absent, the function returns without further object state.
exif points to the byte storage datum of the EXIF profile.
directory is initialized to an interior byte address within the exif storage region at the first IFD offset.
directory_stack entries hold saved directory pointers, entry indices, and tag offsets; popping restores directory, entry, and tag_offset from the stack.
q is an interior byte address within the exif storage region computed from directory and entry.
p is set to q+8, an interior byte address within the exif storage region, when the value fits in the directory entry.
p is set to an interior byte address within the exif storage region at the directory entry's offset when the value does not fit in the directory entry.
p is used as a pointer into the exif storage region for typed reads and byte accesses.
p1 is initialized from p and advanced by size per component, preserving provenance to the exif storage region.
value is allocated as a new string buffer when non-NULL, then released with DestroyString after use.
key is allocated as a new string, then released with DestroyString after use.
exif_resources is a newly created splay tree that is destroyed before the function returns.
states.evidence:
L576: exif_resources=NewSplayTree((int (*)(const void *,const void *)) NULL,
L867: exif_resources=DestroySplayTree(exif_resources);
